faq: Amazon has A+ Content for brand owners, and Walmart and eBay offer rich description areas. Etsy has no such tool, so we focus on photos and text there. We confirm what is possible in your account first.
The marketplace reviews it and decides. We follow the content rules, avoid forbidden claims such as unproven health benefits or price comparisons, and fix any issues if it comes back rejected.
Do you design the graphics too?
Basic and Standard use your photos with text and layout. Premium adds custom icons and infographics. If you need new photography, we give a shot list and can quote photo editing separately.
Can I use competitor names in a comparison chart?
Amazon does not allow naming other brands in comparison charts. We compare your own products, which is allowed, and keep claims truthful and easy to check.
